description: Election Commission - A. Sivakumar Was Selected as the Member of the Valikamam West Pradeshiya Sabha - A. Rajaveni Was Selected as the Member of the Point Pedro Urban Council.
reasoning: This gazette content specifically deals with filling vacancies in local government bodies (Valikamam West Pradeshiya Sabha and Point Pedro Urban Council) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance.
